::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--operations}
Operations Manual
:::

Use the Data Sharing Agreement for approved access to restricted, de-identified record-level data. It is not normally required for aggregate products already approved and published through the Information Hub.

The agreement is managed in the private REDCap Data Access Register. The public website explains the terms but does not collect applicant details or signatures.

## Before issuing an agreement

Confirm in the **BNR Review and Decision** instrument that:

- a public aggregate product cannot meet the need;
- the purpose and minimum necessary dataset are clear;
- ethics and governance requirements have been checked;
- storage and named-user arrangements are acceptable;
- confidentiality and disclosure risk have been considered;
- the approved scope and conditions are recorded; and
- the authorised decision-maker has approved the request.

## Issue the applicant agreement

1. Check the applicant email address and the agreement version.
2. Confirm that the approved scope shown in the agreement is complete and accurate.
3. Send a private, record-specific survey invitation from REDCap.
4. Confirm that the applicant accepted the terms and completed the electronic signature.
5. Check that REDCap stored the certified PDF snapshot.

Do not use the public application link to collect a signature or send a reusable agreement link.

## BNR countersignature

After the applicant has signed, the authorised BNR signatory completes the staff-only countersignature fields on the same instrument. Mark the agreement as executed only when both parties have completed it.

Create and store the final executed agreement PDF in the approved private location. Record its reference in REDCap; do not place it in Git or a public website folder.

## Amendments

Refer the request back for review if the purpose, team, data scope, linkage, storage environment, transfer method or retention period changes. Record the revised decision and issue a new agreement version when the change is material. Do not overwrite the evidence of the agreement previously signed.

## Pre-release check

- [ ] The approved purpose and minimum dataset are clear.
- [ ] Ethics and governance requirements are complete.
- [ ] Named access and storage arrangements are approved.
- [ ] The applicant's certified PDF is present.
- [ ] The authorised BNR role has countersigned.
- [ ] The final executed agreement is stored privately.
- [ ] Release is authorised in the REDCap record.

Only then proceed to the **Release, Monitoring and Closure** instrument and the controlled data-preparation process.
